subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should this bounded Discord retry land as defense in depth alongside the shared reply-session recovery in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920?
rationale: Both patches address the same conflict at different ownership layers; source review can establish that each is valid, but only maintainer intent can decide whether the long-term product keeps both recovery layers or centralizes all policy in shared session code.

options.title: Keep both recovery layers
options.body: Land this narrow Discord retry after exact-head checks, while treating shared session self-heal as the canonical permanent recovery path.

options.title: Centralize in shared recovery
options.body: Pause this PR and require the shared-session PR to prove Discord delivery and replay behavior before dropping the channel-level retry.

options.title: Land Discord first, revisit later
options.body: Merge the proven channel fix now for the P1 message-loss symptom and explicitly schedule removal review after shared recovery ships.

recommendation.title: Keep both recovery layers
recommendation.body: Land this narrow Discord retry after exact-head checks, while treating shared session self-heal as the canonical permanent recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history spans both the Discord handler and shared session lifecycle, and this person is assigned to the PR.
